ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across >95% of visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixels at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across central and proximal regions. High-contrast white clusters localized at the far lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped central depression, angle approximately 115 degrees with shallow depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-10 pixel variations) along the continuous linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both left and right lobes (barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-colored linear marks visible on the surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle clusters at distal tips; multiple fine linear surface abrasions on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of dark pigment across the entire ventral surface.
